commitMessage: BROKEN: restored working tree snapshot for investigation
notes: Fix: gated_delta_rule CUDA kernel FP16 state accumulation bug. Kernel stored recurrent state as T (float16) per-timestep causing exponential quantization error. Now uses persistent thread-local float32 working buffer (matching CPU). Also fixed sigmoidKernel and l2NormalizeKernel in gated_delta_net_block.cu for FP16 overflow. Also fixed MmulHelper usualGemm param swap and rms_norm_linear type mismatch from optimizer. Awaiting rebuild to verify output contains 'France'.
